offering_description.value: The company designs and manufactures firearms for civilian shooters, law enforcement agencies, and military customers. It sells through wholesale distributors, firearms dealers, and direct agency accounts. It also provides contract manufacturing services to other businesses.

primary_products.value: pistols; revolvers; rifles; firearms parts and accessories

primary_services.value: contract forging; machining; precision plastic injection molding

customer_segment.value: B2B: Firearms wholesalers and retailers, and manufacturers that outsource production work; B2C: Recreational shooters, hunters, and personal protection buyers; B2G: Law enforcement agencies and military organizations

end_markets.value: shooting sports; personal protection; hunting; law enforcement and defense; industrial manufacturing

revenue_model.value: product sales: Finished firearms, replacement parts, and accessories; project or contract: Contract forging, machining, and molding for other manufacturers

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Makes finished firearms from metal, polymers, and components for distributors, dealers, and government customers; service provider: Processes metal and plastic into parts for other manufacturers

geography_served.value: global: Primarily the United States, with sales to international markets

specialization.value: related lines: Handguns, long guns, firearms parts and accessories, and contract manufacturing

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: Firearms wholesalers and licensed dealers; direct sales: Law enforcement and military accounts, and contract manufacturing customers; online: Company web store for accessories

regulatory_exposure.value: high: ATF licensing and federal firearms rules govern manufacturing and sales, with additional state restrictions and export controls.

notes: The current scope of third-party manufacturing services is uncertain.
